mapper.select: SELECT distinct sm.* FROM sys_tenant st INNER JOIN sys_tenant_service sts on sts.sys_tenant_id = st.sys_tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_service_module_item ssmi on ssmi.sys_service_id = sts.sys_service_id INNER JOIN sys_service_module ssm on ssm.sys_service_module_id = ssmi.sys_service_module_id and ssm.sys_service_module_status = 0 and ssm.sys_service_module_delete = 0 INNER JOIN sys_menu sm on FIND_IN_SET(sm.sys_menu_id, ssm.sys_service_module_menu_tags2) WHERE st.sys_tenant_id = #{sysTenantId} AND sts.sys_tenant_service_valid_time >= NOW()
